poll.question: Tomorrow, when Hui Ling reaches for her rope, does Dan hand it to her again—or does he finally pick up his own?

options.label: He hands her the rope
options.desc: Some love is letting her choose; trust her, watch her go

options.label: He picks up his own
options.desc: He's been terrified; now he faces the dead himself

options.label: He seals the ramp
options.desc: Fear and love say: not today, not yet, just rest

in_play.label: Take extra rations
in_play.desc: Stay longer, push deeper; weeks of food if the building yields
